title: Construct lossless updates from explicit engineering decisions
statement: The system shall construct complete recording candidates from explicitly targeted actor decisions while preserving omitted content and unrelated bytes, composing only compatible requested edits, and offering equivalent non-writing preview without requiring callers to build storage scaffolding.

what.problem: Whole-file reconstruction and implicit defaults can overwrite neighboring decisions, refresh reviewed subjects, or make a narrow correction depend on unrelated actor decisions.
what.desired_outcome: Actors can supply a bounded meaningful edit or batch and see exactly its intended candidate effects without hidden semantic changes.

why.rationale: Narrow, lossless authoring makes correction practical while retaining the integrity of recorded judgments and unrelated work.

stakeholders: Engineers and reviewers operating on recorded engineering work
Engineering agents acting on explicit actor decisions
Maintainers and consumers of the published command-line interface

conditions: For purpose-specific mutations, batch construction, non-writing previews, and comparisons with advanced complete-byte replacement.

contexts: Named entries and fields in one selected supported change store; candidate construction operates on one coherent before-state.

how.approach: Use the retained closed targeted-operation catalog to replace only named values and necessary syntax or registration bookkeeping. Require explicit applicability on new supporting records, validate the combined final candidate, reject overlap, and keep complete and narrow assessment semantics distinct.

how_much.scope: All targeted operations, creation, narrow explanation edits, explicit finding/blocker corrections, and bounded batch composition. Advanced replacement supplies complete exact candidate bytes rather than targeted edits. No arbitrary repository patch, implicit delete, cross-change batch, semantic default, or automatic retry merge is introduced.

acceptance_criteria: Required semantic inputs are supplied by the actor and missing inputs identify the required field; mechanical record metadata, containers, deterministic paths, and registry entries need not be authored by the caller.

Only named values and necessary adjacent syntax/bookkeeping change. Omitted fields, entry order, unrelated narrative, existing whitespace, and semantically unchanged values retain their bytes; new files follow the retained encoding contract.

A bounded ordered batch constructs one final candidate; valid references to newly introduced entries resolve there. Duplicate or overlapping semantic assignments reject even if equal, while explicitly separate assessment/finding and decision/body spans retain their declared composition rules.

Full Review recording preserves findings; explanation set changes only selected explanation fields. Full Verify replacement removes omitted optional verification_basis, while narrow edits cannot remove or refresh it or silently change applicability, actors, subjects, or judgment.

Preview constructs and validates the same intended candidate without publication, transaction files, reservation, or saved claim. Actual execution repeats freshness checks and does not treat preview as authority.

Registered missing content and existing unregistered files cannot be treated as empty creation targets. Advanced explicit restoration remains subject to exact content and all normal safety requirements.
